title: V, W, X
summary: Learn V, W, X, then practise with the keys you already know.
intro: Learn V, W, X, then practise with the keys you already know.

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press v to type V. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: VfV ffV VVV VV fVff VVVf Vfff

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press w to type W. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: WW WWjW Wj WWW WWWW WWjj jjWW WjW

screens.text: Hold Shift with the little finger of your right hand and press x to type X. Release Shift before the next key.
screens.content: XXfX XX XfXX fXXf XXX fX XXXX fXX fXXX

screens.text: Type each target carefully, then return to the home position before the next one.
screens.content: VXVX VWWW XXVX VV WVVX VWW XVX WVXW VVXV WMVV qXW XXXM WW XV WX XXX
